description: This course provides an on-campus immersion experience for students interested in
improving their oral language proficiency. Students engage in small and large group
discussion, give individual and group oral presentations, and review grammar and
registers of language. They also explore the notions of communicative competence and oral
proficiency in order to become more effective speakers. Taught in French.
Offered at least alternate years; one 250-level course will be offered each fall and spring
semester. Prerequisite: FREN 232 or FREN 235 or FREN 237, or equivalent.
